sourceUpdate.title: Voces de otros tiempos. Lenguas originarias del noreste de México — selected methodological discussion
sourceUpdate.author: Moises Valadez Moreno (as printed on the article)
sourceUpdate.publisher: Noroeste de México / Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia
sourceUpdate.publicationDate: Date unresolved: article received/accepted in 2024; PDF running header identifies January–June 2022
sourceUpdate.annotation: Selected methodological pages explain the author’s reorganization of earlier vocabulary lists and discuss disputed language classifications. This is a secondary reconstruction, not a new speaker survey. The article also makes sweeping disappearance claims; those are the author’s assertions and are not adopted as evidence that descendants ceased to exist. The vocabulary tables were not systematically evaluated.
sourceUpdate.contentReviewScope: Actual public 54-page publisher PDF: printed pp. 164–169 (PDF1–6); the ‘Lenguas y voces’ methodological passage on p.172 (PDF9); and final comments on p.206 (PDF43). References on pp.207 and215–217 inspected as locators only. Title page visually inspected. Full vocabulary tables and intervening sections were not content-reviewed; cited original works were not independently inspected.
sourceUpdate.countReason: Retained as inspected supporting criticism of a secondary reconstruction. Partial scope and unresolved broad claims do not warrant promoting the earlier lead into an excellent substantive work merely to increase the count.

inspectedSubresources.title: Actual publisher PDF
inspectedSubresources.scope: Selected printed pp.164–169,172(methodological passage),206;54-page PDF not read in full.

sourceUpdate.accessNotes: Public Spanish PDF with English abstract downloaded normally through PowerShell; no reader account or paywall encountered. The article-record route returned a server error and web-tool PDF retrieval timed out, but actual PDF text was accessible and selected content read. Printed first page states received January13,2024 and accepted April15,2024; running headers say Noroeste de México, nueva época,no.5,January–June2022. Publication chronology is unresolved. No vocabulary, maps, ceremonial detail, archaeological locations or images reproduced; link-only use.

gapCorrection: Selected methodological and final-comment pages of the INAH language-history article have now been inspected. Its vocabulary tables and cited originals remain unevaluated, its broad disappearance assertions are not adopted, and its publication dates conflict internally. More focused community-directed and specialist language evidence remains needed.
